title: Ejecutivo de Onboarding de Marketplace
description:
About the job

Objetivo general del puesto:

Ejecutar acciones dirigidas a la búsqueda, adquisición y onboarding de nuevos Sellers estratégicos rentables y con una amplia oferta de catálogo, así como relevantes en otros Marketplaces a nivel mundial, por medio de la implementación de estrategias en las categorías a su cargo, brindando las herramientas necesarias para que los Sellers estratégicos puedan operar de forma exitosa en el Marketplace de Coppel.




Responsabilidades:

• Asegurar e implementar negociaciones con Sellers estratégicos en OnBoarding, para establecer una estrategia de catálogo y precio que ayude a apalancar la venta, oferta y rotación del inventario de solo Sellers estratégicos.

• Asegurar el desempeño (performance) de cada uno de los niveles comerciales, operativos, de embarque y niveles de servicio hacia el Cliente final de cara a las métricas de nuestro Marketplace, siendo clave para evaluar y calificar el desempeño de un Seller para ser administrado por un Líder de Marketplace o a un esquema sin asesoramiento.

• Participar en la planeación anual de Onboarding la cual se estructura mediante herramientas específicas para realizar estrategias de acuerdo a la temporalidad del año (como paid media y tendencias de mercado) de acuerdo a herramientas de medición (Nubimetrics, Real Trends, AMVO, Euromonitor, Statista, Wiser) con el objetivo de definir la mejor oferta de acuerdo al complemento de 1P (eCommerce) y 3P (Marketplace).

• Colaborar en la visión de crecimiento de eCommerce (incremento de % de participación de venta en el Grupo) por medio del fortalecimiento del Marketplace, volviendolo un jugador relevante para la aportación de la venta a nivel Grupo.

• Evaluar las necesidades existentes y potenciales de los Sellers, adecuando la estrategia de onboarding a los requerimientos de ventas, inventarios y promociones con el objetivo de incrementar el número de Sellers activos, el catálogo de productos y el volumen de ventas.

• Impulsar la estrategia de reclutamiento de nuevos vendedores para el marketplace de Coppel, manteniendo contacto con nuevos prospectos a través de visitas presenciales, llamadas, videollamadas, con el objetivo de presentar y promover los beneficios del modelo operativo comercial, así como tomar decisiones acerca del ingreso de vendedores estratégicos que contribuyan directamente a las metas de crecimiento del negocio.

• Supervisar todo el proceso de onboarding del vendedor, desde el primer contacto hasta que su tienda se encuentre lista para operar en la plataforma (proceso de alta y capacitación) actuando como el contacto principal, con el objetivo de garantizar la integración adecuada del vendedor al marketplace de Coppel.

• Proponer vendedores potenciales a través de la participación en eventos de marketplace y/o eCommerce para incrementar la oferta y artículos para el catálogo del Marketplace de Coppel.

• Contribuir al cumplimiento de metas, por medio del monitoreo del desempeño del equipo y ajuste de estrategias por categoría que lleven al negocio hacia los estándares de servicio establecidos.

• Proponer mejoras al proceso de onboarding a través de la identificación de cuellos de botella, para reducir tiempos de activación y capacitación de los vendedores.




Escolaridad:

Licenciatura en Negocios Internacionales, Administración de Empresas, Mercadotecnia, Finanzas, Informática, Economía, Comercio Internacional o Ingeniería Industrial.




Certificados o licencias complementarias:

Metodologías de trabajo ágil: Kanban Boards.

Diplomado en Operaciones y Mejora continua, eCommerce, gestión y mejora de procesos.




Otros conocimientos:

• eCommerce.

• Negociación.

• Seguimiento cuentas AAA.

• Manejo de objeciones.

• Funcionamiento del marketplace (manejo de la interfaz, proceso de carga de productos, políticas y procedimientos, integraciones).

• Habilidades y procesos de capacitación.




Experiencia:




3 años como Ejecutivo de Cuentas Clave, Analista de Operaciones eCommerce (Performance, desarrollo de nuevos negocios).

2 años como Asesor Comercial para sellers en distintas plataformas digitales.










Beneficios:

● Sueldo base

● Fondo de ahorro

● Descuentos en compras de muebles y ropa

● Aguinaldo

● Vacaciones

● Prima vacacional

● Reparto de utilidades

● Día libre de cumpleaños

● Becas para estudio

● Útiles escolares

● Club de protección familiar

● Ambiente de trabajo agradable

● Entre otros beneficios y prestaciones

About the job

We're Invesp — the leading conversion optimization agency in North America. We've run over 36,000 A/B tests, helping companies like eBay, 3M, and O'Reilly increase conversions and grow revenue through data-driven experimentation.

We're looking for a Junior Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Specialist who's eager to learn, curious about user behavior, and excited to build a career in experimentation, UX, analytics, and conversion optimization.

At Invesp, you can bring your most authentic self to work, merging your personal and professional lives while collaborating with a team of passionate CRO experts.


What you will do:

Analyze websites, landing pages, and customer journeys to identify conversion opportunities.
Assist in developing hypotheses for A/B tests using data, user research, and best practices.
Collaborate with designers to ensure proposed solutions align with experiment hypotheses.
Work closely with developers and QA to help deliver high-quality A/B experiments.
Monitor experiment performance and assist with post-test analysis and reporting.
Support senior strategists in identifying optimization opportunities that improve user experience and business results.
Continuously learn and apply CRO, UX, usability, and experimentation best practices.


What we are looking for:

0–2 years of experience in digital marketing, analytics, ecommerce, UX, CRO, or a related field.
A strong analytical mindset and passion for solving problems with data.
Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
Ability to work proactively, independently, and collaboratively in a remote environment.
Curiosity, ownership, and a desire to continuously learn and improve.


Nice to have:

Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
Basic understanding of A/B testing and experimentation.
Knowledge of UX principles, customer journey mapping, or usability.
Experience with Google Tag Manager, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Looker Studio, or Excel.
Exposure to ecommerce, SaaS, or digital marketing campaigns.


Why join Invesp?

100% remote-first team — we've been remote since before it was cool.
Learn from one of the world's most experienced conversion optimization agencies.
Hands-on experience working on real CRO programs and experimentation projects.
Clear ownership of your work with autonomy, mentorship, and support.
Fast-growing, well-respected agency with top-tier clients and a 90%+ client retention rate.
Smart, humble, and data-driven teammates who genuinely enjoy what they do.
Continuous learning and excellent opportunities for career growth in CRO and experimentation.


Weorking hours

We welcome applicants from around the world. For candidates outside North and South America, this role requires availability for internal and client meetings primarily within North American and European time zones.

Your core working hours will be 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM CST, Monday through Friday, with the remainder of your schedule being flexible around these core commitments.


Join our team:

This is a full-time, remote position. We care less about where you went to school and more about how you think, communicate, take ownership, and approach problem-solving.

If you're curious, collaborative, and excited to help great companies grow through data-driven experimentation and conversion optimization, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today or send us a direct message—we'd love to talk.

Career details interview (60–75 minutes)
Cultural interview (60–75 minutes)

description:
About the job

At Playlist, life's richest moments happen when people step away from screens to move, connect, explore, and play. We're building the definitive platform for intentional living, connecting people with inspiring experiences in fitness, wellness, and beyond. With popular brands like Mindbody and ClassPass, Playlist empowers businesses and individuals, making it effortless for aspirations to become actions. Join us in reshaping technology's role to foster meaningful, real-world connections.

Mindbody equips wellness entrepreneurs with technology to support thriving businesses and create exceptional experiences. Innovation and curiosity drive our culture, connecting businesses and individuals through cutting-edge solutions. Join us if you're passionate about enhancing wellness through technology.

Who we are

Creativity, collaboration, and camaraderie shape how Mindbody's Marketing team works. In a dynamic, data-led environment, we develop strategic B2B and consumer marketing initiatives that respond to an evolving landscape. Together, we're strengthening Mindbody's position as a trusted software provider for fitness, beauty, and wellness businesses.

The Role You'll Play

We're looking for an Associate Visual Designer to support a variety of B2B SaaS marketing initiatives across content, web, email, video, social media, advertising, and brand campaigns. You'll bring familiarity with Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, including After Effects, while building your skills and developing a strong understanding of the Mindbody brand.


Collaborate with visual designers, copywriters, project managers, and stakeholders to bring creative ideas to life
Create thoughtful, engaging designs tailored to the needs of different marketing channels and asset types
Apply Mindbody's brand guidelines consistently across campaigns and communications
Manage multiple projects while delivering accurate, high-quality work on time and aligned with each brief
Use core design principles to establish clear hierarchy, effective layouts, and cohesive visual storytelling
Communicate ideas clearly and incorporate feedback to strengthen the final work


The Experience You’ll Bring


1+ years of graphic design experience, including exposure to marketing, with B2B experience preferred
A portfolio featuring professional work beyond academic projects
Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and PowerPoint
Experience with Adobe After Effects and foundational motion design
Strong understanding of graphic design principles, visual hierarchy, screen layout, color theory, motion, and typography
Ability to apply current design trends and best practices to compelling marketing work

title: COORDINADOR DE PLANEACIÓN Y SUPPLY CHAIN
description:
About the job

COORDINADOR DE PLANEACIÓN Y SUPPLY CHAIN

INGENIERO INDUSTRIAL O AFIN 

Ubicación: Monterrey, Nuevo León

Empresa: MUTUO Maquila de Ropa Deportiva

Modalidad: Presencial

Experiencia: 5 a 8 años

Sueldo: $35,000 a $40,000 brutos mensuales + prestaciones

OBJETIVO DEL PUESTO

Buscamos un Ingeniero Industrial o afín, altamente estructurado, analítico y orientado a procesos, para coordinar la planeación de demanda, materiales, abastecimiento, inventarios y logística de una empresa manufacturera en crecimiento.

Esta posición tendrá un papel clave en la profesionalización de la operación.

Buscamos una persona que tenga capacidad para analizar, anticiparse, ordenar información, crear controles y desarrollar procesos sólidos que permitan crecer la empresa con mayor control y que sea altamente opertiva también.

Trabajará directamente con Dirección, Producción y diversas maquilas a nivel nacional.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALESPLANEACIÓN DE DEMANDA Y PRODUCCIÓN

· Consolidar pedidos confirmados y proyectos próximos.

· Mantener actualizado el plan de demanda.

· Traducir pedidos de clientes en necesidades de materiales y fechas.

· Dar visibilidad de la carga de trabajo de las siguientes semanas.

· Identificar anticipadamente riesgos de faltantes o retrasos.

· Coordinarse con Producción para validar capacidad y fechas compromiso.

· Dar seguimiento semanal al cumplimiento del plan.

· Desarrollar gradualmente mejores herramientas de forecast y planeación.

PLANEACIÓN DE MATERIALES

· Determinar requerimientos de telas, avíos, empaques y demás materiales necesarios para producción.

· Validar existencias antes de generar compras.

· Considerar inventarios, consumos, lead times y fechas de producción.

· Generar alertas anticipadas de materiales críticos.

· Reducir compras urgentes y faltantes que detengan producción.

· Apoyar en la construcción de mínimos, máximos y puntos de reorden.

COMPRAS Y ABASTECIMIENTO

· Generar y dar seguimiento a órdenes de compra.

· Solicitar y comparar cotizaciones.

· Negociar condiciones básicas con proveedores.

· Confirmar fechas compromiso.

· Dar seguimiento hasta la recepción completa del material.

· Mantener actualizada la información de proveedores, precios y tiempos de entrega.

· Buscar nuevas alternativas de suministro cuando sea necesario.

· Evaluar cumplimiento de proveedores.

INVENTARIOS

· Mejorar la exactitud de inventarios.

· Coordinar entradas y salidas de materiales.

· Implementar conteos cíclicos.

· Identificar faltantes, diferencias, sobreinventarios y materiales de lento movimiento.

· Desarrollar controles sencillos de cobertura y rotación.

· Asegurar trazabilidad de materiales destinados a cada orden de producción.

LOGÍSTICA

· Coordinar recolecciones y entregas.

· Dar seguimiento a transportistas.

· Coordinar movimientos de mercancía entre proveedores, planta, maquilas externas y clientes.

· Llevar control de fechas compromiso.

· Analizar incidencias y retrasos.

· Buscar mejoras en rutas, tiempos y costos.

· Mantener visibilidad del estatus de cada entrega.

PROCESOS Y SISTEMAS

Una parte importante del puesto será ayudar a transformar actividades actualmente manuales en procesos más estructurados.

Esperamos que la persona pueda:

· Documentar procesos.

· Crear formatos y controles.

· Construir indicadores.

· Mejorar bases de datos.

· Automatizar reportes.

· Identificar información que actualmente no se está controlando.

· Participar en la implementación y mejora del ERP.

· Ayudar a establecer responsables y flujos de trabajo.

· Utilizar Excel y herramientas digitales para mejorar la toma de decisiones.

No esperamos que la persona llegue con todas las respuestas ni que implemente por sí sola un sistema corporativo complejo.

Sí esperamos que tenga la capacidad de decir:

“Esto actualmente se controla así; propongo ordenarlo de esta manera y medirlo con estos indicadores.”

INDICADORES PRINCIPALES

· Pedidos entregados a tiempo.

· Materiales disponibles a tiempo para producción.

· Número de faltantes.

· Compras urgentes.

· Cumplimiento de proveedores.

· Exactitud de inventario.

· Rotación de inventarios.

· Órdenes de compra vencidas.

· Entregas logísticas a tiempo.

· Diferencia entre plan y ejecución.

PERFILFormación

Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería en Manufactura, Ingeniería Mecánica Administrativa, Ingeniería en Logística o carrera afín.

Experiencia

5 a 8 años de experiencia profesional, preferentemente en empresas de manufactura.

Buscamos experiencia real en al menos tres de las siguientes áreas:

· Planeación de demanda.

· Planeación de producción.

· Planeación de materiales.

· MRP.

· Compras.

· Inventarios.

· Logística.

· Supply Chain.

Será especialmente valorada experiencia en empresas con múltiples SKUs, producción contra pedido y operaciones de manufactura.

Herramientas

Indispensable:

· Excel avanzado.

· Tablas dinámicas.

· Fórmulas avanzadas.

· Análisis de información.

· Experiencia trabajando con ERP o MRP.

Muy deseable:

· Power Query.

· Power BI.

· SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, Odoo, Zoho u otro ERP.

· Experiencia creando dashboards y KPIs.

PERFIL PERSONAL

Buscamos una persona:

· Muy estructurada.

· Analítica.

· Numérica.

· Con iniciativa.

· Con excelente seguimiento.

· Con sentido de urgencia.

· Ordenada.

· Capaz de priorizar.

· Cómoda trabajando en una empresa en crecimiento.

· Capaz de trabajar con procesos que todavía se están construyendo.

· Que no necesite recibir instrucciones para cada actividad.

· Con mentalidad de mejora continua.

· Con capacidad para cuestionar y proponer.

About the job

.NET Fullstack Developer - Consultant – Americas Delivery Mexico (ADMX) 




Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology? A .NET Fullstack Developer - Consultant who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced .NET Fullstack Developer - Consultant, you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. Americas Delivery Mexico (ADMX) leverages scale and talent to provide high quality, cost-effective service to our clients. 




ADMX is a member of the Global Delivery Network which has presence across the world with Delivery centers in the United States, Romania, India, Spain, China, and the Philippines. ADMX is in Queretaro, Mexico. We provide consulting services to help our clients achieve a higher level of service in operational efficiency and business value. We are a team of professionals passionate about serving clients with distinction and learning, and we are driven by our purpose: Making an impact that matters for our clients, our people, and society.




Work you’ll do/Responsibilities 




As a Consultant at Deloitte, you will work within an engagement team and be responsible for supporting the overall project goals and objectives. In this role, you will interact with stakeholders and cross-functional teams. It is expected that you will be able to perform independent tasks as well as provide technical guidance to team members, as needed. 




We are looking for a .NET Fullstack Developer to build and maintain complete web applications within the Microsoft ecosystem. They bridge the gap between user interfaces and server




The Team 




Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You’ll work alongside talented professionals in reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.




Qualifications




Required

3-5+ years of consulting and/or industry experience.
Completion of course of study/Egresado in Computer Science/IT/Computer Engineering, or any pertinent field or industry, or equivalent years of experience.
Responsible for supporting and independently completing project tasks.

Experience with SQL server, or any relational schemas, ORMS (like Entity framework).

RESTful API design, version control (GIT). 
Understanding design patterns. 
Unit testing. 

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Mexico at the time of hire; limited sponsorship may be available for this role based on business needs and applicable law.




Preferred 




Understanding of CI/CD pipelines. 




Our people and culture




Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute to their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ideas and perspectives and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work. 




Professional development




From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership opportunities and connect, and grow through mentorship. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career.




Accommodations

description:
About the job

Description

The LATAM CFX team is looking for a talented, smart, and entrepreneurial Business Intelligence Analyst (BA) to help us build an exceptional Customer Fulfillment Experience (CFX) in the complex and exciting Concessions (NCRC) and Returns Experience (RCX) space to support LATAM fast-paced growth.

As a Business Intelligence Analyst (BA) in this team, you will be responsible for driving and building data & analytics solutions to identify, prevent, anticipate, solve for customer pain points, network defects, abuse behaviors, policy and catalog gaps, and opportunities throughout the purchase and post-purchase journey in MX and BR.

As a Business Intelligence Analyst (BA), you'll be at the heart of Amazon's data-driven culture, building programmatic and analytics solutions that power intelligent business decisions and solve opportunities about concessions, returns experience & policies, operating procedures, network and product/program's logic. Your insights will shape strategy, drive customer satisfaction, and drive business growth and profitability across one of Amazon's most critical areas.

You will partner closely with MX/BR NCRC & Returns PMs, BIE Leads and Engineers, Operations Managers, and IES BIE/Applied Scientists to solve business problems and should be skilled at translating complex or ambiguous problem statements into analytic requirements.

Additionally, you will act in an analytic consultative capacity and can both articulate the “so-what” of your analytic results and model potential/real outcomes of proposed solutions to senior leadership.

A successful candidate will develop a strong understanding of our business and make data-driven conclusions and programmatic solutions with direct impact in Amazon's profitability. They will be comfortable with ambiguity and learning new analytical skills, while working in a fast-paced dynamic environment.

Key job responsibilities

Strategic Insights and Solutions

You follow Amazon product development best practices and work backwards to identify gaps and defects in customers shopping journey.

Spearhead business intelligence & data analytics initiatives that directly impact Amazon's profitability.

You develop advanced analytical tools and models to uncover hidden business opportunities.

Present compelling insights, business models, programs, workflows, policies recommendations to senior leadership, influencing key decisions.

Innovate with Advanced Analytics

Harness the power of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI to generate business impact

Lead data-driven discussions with Product and Operations teams to accelerate growth and solve for leakages

Pioneer new methodologies in returns experience, abuse and defect analytics, setting industry standards

Create intuitive and automated analytical tools that transform complex data into clear, actionable insights

Continuously innovate and simplify tools and processes, maximizing impact

Influence Through Communication

Craft compelling narratives from data, influencing key stakeholders

Develop effective metrics that shape the future of Amazon's purchase, delivery and returns experience

Collaborate across teams to drive adoption of data-driven strategies

About The Team

Joining the CFX team means partnering with a dynamic and creative group who set a high bar for innovation and success in a fast-paced and changing environment.

We are looking for a leader with super-powers in analytics and getting things done (a not-that-frequent combination!).

Basic Qualifications


 2+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
 Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
 Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)
 Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)


Preferred Qualifications


 Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
 Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
 Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

About the job

About The Team

Zillow started in 2006 and is the most visited real estate website in the United States with over 10.5 billion visits in 2022, and an average of 220 million monthly unique users. Zillow helps high-intent movers find and win their home through digital solutions and first class partners. Our Zillow Mexico team will work with our US tech teams to simplify and automate the buying, selling and renting experience to make home a reality for more and more people.


 We believe that creativity, collaboration, and innovation lead to success. 
 We actively encourage our teams to learn about the business and share


their ideas.


 We value and promote a diverse and inclusive workplace!


About The Role

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you’ll lead the delivery and ongoing support of projects from end-to-end. In addition, you will:


Contribute to the design of new features. 
Review the code of your peers. 
Advocate for standard methodologies. 
Facilitate engineering discussions. 
Mentor junior engineers. 
Participate in an inclusive, energetic and highly multi-functional team. 


This role has been categorized as a teleworker position. Teleworkers do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and instead work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events.

In addition to a competitive base salary and benefits, this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location.

Who you are

Wondering if we're the right team for you? You'll excel in this team if you thrive on autonomy, seek out persistent problems, implement effective solutions quickly, and you are:


Bringing 5+ years of software development experience with ES6, React, Typescript, and GraphQL to power our web and mobile web applications and Python, Java, NodeJS, and Go for APIs and services. 
Experienced in a range of persistence strategies including relational and non-relational databases. 
Fluent in English and Spanish (both written and spoken). 
Must be authorized to work in Mexico. 
Highly skilled with multiple modern development technologies used to design, deliver, debug, and maintain front-end user interfaces and back-end software systems. 
Recognized as a technical leader on your team for several years and have an impact beyond your team. 
Passionate about setting standard methodologies and raising the bar for systems design, testing, code quality, and maintainability - not only for the team but for the entire engineering organization!
Here at Zillow we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experiences. 


Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the country. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
About the job

We're a growing CPA / performance-marketing agency based in Mexico City. We've moved past

our early stage — steady client base, healthy inbound — and now we're building a repeatable

outbound engine. We're looking for a Business Development Representative to own the top of

our funnel: find the right prospects, open conversations, and book qualified meetings. You

bring the pipeline; the founder closes.

Heads up. This is a hunter role. Most of your outreach will get a "no" — we're looking for

someone who bounces back and keeps going.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Run outbound prospecting across email, LinkedIn, and calls to a curated target list

• Qualify inbound leads and route the good ones into booked meetings

• Book qualified discovery calls for the founder to close

• Keep the CRM clean and current — every contact, deal, and stage logged

• Nurture warm leads over longer cycles until they're ready to talk

• Report on pipeline metrics weekly: activity, meetings booked, conversion




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• A hunter's mindset: resilient, persistent, comfortable with rejection and volume

• Fluent English (client-facing with US / international clients); native or fluent Spanish

• Strong written and verbal communication

• Discipline with CRM and data — you keep your pipeline tidy without being told

• Self-starter, coachable, and eager to grow toward closing

• 1+ year in outreach, sales, partnerships, or a comparable people-facing role (influencer or

partner outreach counts)




NICE TO HAVE

• Experience at an agency, in B2B sales, or in CPA / affiliate / performance marketing

• Familiarity with a CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive) and outreach tooling

• A track record of hitting activity or meeting targets




COMPENSATION & LOGISTICS

• Location: Mexico City, remote / hybrid, with hours overlapping US time zones

• Competitive base + uncapped commission (per qualified meeting + closed-deal bonus)

• Direct work with the Founder, real ownership, and a fast path toward closing.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE · FIRST 90 DAYS

• 10 qualified meetings booked per month (ramping ~4 → 7 → 10 over the first three months)

• CRM 100% clean and current

• Measurable contribution to growing the client base from 2 to 5+

About the job

Responsibilities

About the team

TikTok Shop's Governance and Experience (GNE) is a global team that safeguards trust across our e-commerce marketplace — for buyers, sellers, and creators alike. We set the policies and rules that help sellers and creators grow in a fair, thriving ecosystem, detect and prevent fraud and abuse, and design the service and experience that resolve issues and build lasting trust with our customers. Partnering closely with business, product, engineering, and legal teams — and increasingly harnessing AI to govern and serve at scale — our work is what lets buyers shop with confidence, sellers and creators grow sustainably, and the business scale worldwide.

We're looking for passionate, curious people who care deeply about user experience and thrive on complex, high-stakes challenges. If you want your ideas to matter and your work to drive real impact, join us in building the future of e-commerce.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.

Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.

Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.

What's this role about?

The Governance team builds a thriving, safe, and fair marketplace ecosystem on TikTok Shop — shaping the policies, programs, and risk controls that help sellers and creators grow responsibly. As a Governance Intern, you'll work on real projects with the [Region] team and get first-hand exposure to how a global platform designs and enforces its rules at scale, including with AI.

Examples Of What You'll Work On


 Assist in research on market regulations, industry practices, and emerging risks.
 Support data checks and analysis to monitor governance metrics and identify trends or root causes
 Help review real cases to surface insights that inform policy and enforcement improvements
 Support AI-assisted governance workflows: e.g. helping test prompts and evaluate the quality of AI-assisted outcomes
 Help prepare documentation, reporting, and cross-team communication for governance programs.

 Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Data Science, Law/Public Policy, or related fields.
 Able to commit to a full-time internship of at least 3 months (please state your availability in your resume)
 Professional proficiency in English and Spanish
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable working with data
 Proactive, curious, and eager to learn in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment


Preferred Qualifications


 Comfort using AI tools in daily work is a plus; SQL/Python is a plus

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. About the job

POSITION TITLE:Style Expert

DIVISION / DEPARTEMENT:Fashion / Retail

REPORTING TO: Boutique Sales Manager

FUNCTIONAL: Style Expertise Manager

LOCATION:  Fashion Boutiques – Mexico City

At CHANEL, we are focused on creating an inclusive culture that nurtures personal growth, contributing to collective progress. We believe the uniqueness of each individual increases the diversity, complementarity, and effectiveness of our teams. We strongly encourage your application, as we value the perspective, experience, and potential you could bring to CHANEL.

We are looking for a Style Expert to join the CHANEL boutiques in Mexico City.

About The Role In Boutique

Creation is at the heart of Maison CHANEL and its fashion heritage. As the client journey evolves and becomes more personal, it is expanding beyond collections and products. To offer a unique CHANEL client experience and match their ever-increasing expectations, our retail teams, especially local ones, are our brand ambassadors. Through their personalized approach and human touch, they ought to provide personalized and custom style advice, steering each client towards finding their unique Style and Allure at CHANEL.

What Impact You Can Create At Chanel

As a Style Expert, you act as the « Style relay » in the boutique between the Style Expertise Manager and the Style Advisor and / or Fashion Advisors (FAs). Thanks to your luxury fashion flair, styling skills and sophistication, you work as a Style Consultant with Clients mainly focusing on wardrobe appointments and styling sessions. You also mentor the Style Advisors and the Fashion Advisors and play a key role in elevating the styling competencies in your boutique.

ENGAGE CLIENTS WITH THE STYLE OF CHANEL



Deliver expert styling advice linked to the Style of CHANEL & the style of the collection
Inspire clients to explore styles beyond their usual preferences
Provide a style service to clients with a primarily focus on wardrobe appointments
Lead elevated and personalized client styling appointments, the Art of Styling Moments, from the preparation to the execution
Participate in various boutique events as a style referent 
Partner with Boutique management peers to build yearly plan and support business from a styling point of view 
Be proactive in suggesting ways to promote statement pieces and slow movers, working closely with the Style Expertise Manager



ELEVATE THE STYLING COMPETENCIES IN BOUTIQUE & MENTOR STYLE ADVISORS / FASHION ADVISORS



Work closely with the Style expertise manager in developing and supporting the team in styling
Lead styling activities in your boutique to convey the style expertise content (the Style of CHANEL and of the collections) through regular practice 
Animate Style collection workshops at the time of launch and throughout the collection selling period
Monitor the internal styling app, the Fashion Community, for the users of your boutique and suggest best practices Support Style Advisors / FAs in preparing their clients’ appointments 
Coach Style Advisors and FAs through one-to-one sessions
Provide frequent and constructive feedback to Style Advisors FAs and suggest yearly development plan Identify talents with styling skills 
Rotate in boutiques w/o Style experts



INFLUENCE BOUTIQUE BUYS FROM AN ALLURE PERSPECTIVE



During buying session: participate in decoding the collection and gather feedback from the team on the allure of the collection
Review the buys with the boutique management team to ensure the allure of the show is well represented, for the clients of today and tomorrow
Participate actively in all post-buy Meetings and help Style Expertise Manager to share suggestions from a Styling perspective with the rest of the team 



YOU ARE ENERGISED BY:



Art, beauty and luxury
The Fashion world, history and trends
The heritage of The House of CHANEL and the Style of CHANEL
Offering styling as a credible service to clients
Conveying your passion to clients and the team



WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE TEAM:



Passion for the House of CHANEL, its history, its creations, and commitment to social and cultural initiatives
The transmission of your Fashion and Style knowledge
Understanding of, and passion for client experience
Desire to make everyone grow in their styling path within the world of CHANEL



YOUR QUALIFICATIONS:



You have at least 5 years of experience in Fashion luxury retail environment
You have excellent communication skills
You show empathy
You like to work in team, and you show strong team spirit 
You are trustworthy with a high degree of integrity and ethics
You are decisive and performance oriented
You have a passion for client experience, luxury and beauty
You are an ambassador of the CHANEL allure (posture and vocabulary)
You speak Spanish and English. French is a plus

description:
About the job

Job description:



Fondato nel 1913 in Italia, il Gruppo Prada si è costruito su una tradizione di eccellenza e con una visione di innovazione. Il Gruppo, leader mondiale nel settore del lusso, opera in oltre 45 paesi con i marchi PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church's, Car Shoe e Luna Rossa e conta dipendenti di oltre 100 nazionalità.

 

 

JOB PURPOSE

To be the “ambassador” who convey and promote the Brand philosophy and Values to the final Clients guiding them into the world of the Brands. As such, to be responsible to maximize the individual and team sales, providing an extraordinary and memorable luxury customer experience placing the Client above all, discovering their needs and expectations, fostering meaningful relationships and developing their Brand loyalty.

RESPONSIBILITIES

 

Place the Customer at the center, creating a welcoming environment and striving to meet their every need and request, providing them with an excellence service in accordance to the “client journey ceremony”.
Capture Customer data into the Company CRM with the purpose of connecting to the client, maintaining and developing the relationships to offer a personalized approach and develop future opportunities.
Embrace and promote the Omni Channel mindset.
Work as a team player and partner with fellow colleagues, foster open and constructive communication, to ensure a consistent exceptional experience and contribute to a positive working environment, embracing Diversity and inclusion values.
Welcome and serve the customer providing an excellent in-store experience at all times.
Be proactively engaged in cross selling with all Departments and maximizes sales opportunity in order to achieve individual sales target and KPIs.
Ensure to be up-to-date knowing fashion trends and competitors.
Prove Brand and product knowledge.
Deal effectively with customer complaints by liaising with the line manager when necessary.
Ensure and maintain the shop floor and visual display high standard, complying with Company operational guidelines and stock procedures.
Contribute to ensure a high level of security and is attentive to prevent product thefts.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Curiosity and interest in luxury/fashion, art and design

Experience of building a long-lasting relationship with clients

Being able to work in team as well as alone

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Ambition, resilience, self motivation, result driven and problem solving

 

 

Entrare a far parte della nostra Azienda significa lavorare in un ambiente creativo e internazionale, con team di persone motivate dalla curiosità e dalla ricerca dell'eccellenza. Il motore del nostro successo è l'importanza e il valore che diamo al talento e alla passione delle nostre persone, favorendone la crescita professionale.
Il Gruppo Prada promuove un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, garantendo pari opportunità a tutti i candidati, indipendentemente da genere, etnia, orientamento sessuale, disabilità, o altre caratteristiche personali. Crediamo che la diversità sia un valore e ci impegniamo a costruire un ambiente di lavoro equo e rispettoso per tutti.

About the job

Modelo de trabajo: En sitio

Empleador: TP Laser, S. de R.L.

Acerca del rol 

Uber Freight Mexico Customs, powered by TP Laser está en búsqueda de profesionistas de atención al cliente con experiencia en el campo de Importación y Exportación. Nuestros especialistas desarrollarán las actividades de monitorear, gestionar y administrar las funciones de transporte y aduanas para garantizar la entrega precisa y oportuna del producto de la manera más eficiente y rentable, con el fin de brindar un excelente servicio al cliente.

Actividades Esenciales


 Atención a clientes (Revisión y seguimiento de la carga, asi como del progreso de las operaciones aduaneras) 
Solicitar documentos y coordinar el despacho aduanero de las mercancías, asi como el aseguramiento del cumplimiento de RRNA (fracciones arancelarias, permisos, avisos automáticos, etc) 
Reportar cualquier discrepancia, daño de mercancía o estatus de su embarque al cliente. 
Captura de pedimentos (marítimo, aereo, ferrocarril, terrestre, operaciones especiales) 
Apertura y cierre de pedimentos consolidados. 
Elaboración de remesas. 
Llenado del pedimento conforme el anexo 22 
Manejo de base de datos y reporteo (Excel)

0-2 años de experiencia relacionada al Comercio Exterior 
Conocimiento en Legislación Aduanera y de Comercio Exterior 
Licenciatura en Comercio Exterior, Logistica o afín 
Conocimiento básico de sistemas de captura de pedimentos 


Cualificaciones Preferidas 


Ingles Básico 
Manejo de Office 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) 


Acerca de TP Laser

Uber Freight Mexico Customs, powered by TP Laser como socio comercial de Uber Freight en México, ofrece servicios personalizados de despacho aduanal entre México y Estados Unidos, respaldados por una combinación inigualable de tecnología innovadora y un equipo dedicado de expertos en materia de comercio exterior que ofrece tranquilidad a través de SOPs estandarizados y nuestra plataforma única, Customs Portal, que brinda total control y visibilidad de operaciones aduanales. Esto crea una experiencia de extremo a extremo sin interrupciones, integrándose plenamente con todas las soluciones logísticas de Uber Freight.

EEOC

TP Laser se enorgullece de ser un empleador de igualdad de oportunidades/acción afirmativa. Todos los solicitantes calificados recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, origen nacional, discapacidad, estado de veterano protegido, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley. También consideramos solicitantes calificados independientemente de sus antecedentes penales, de acuerdo con los requisitos legales.

title: Senior CRM & Salesforce Marketing Cloud Strategy Lead

Traducir objetivos comerciales en casos de uso accionables, incluyendo journeys automatizados, segmentaciones, campañas multicanal, programas de lifecycle, loyalty, onboarding, nurturing, cross-sell, up-sell y reactivación.

Liderar la definición funcional de campañas de marketing directo en email, SMS, WhatsApp, push u otros canales propios, asegurando consistencia entre audiencia, mensaje, canal, timing, frecuencia y KPI.

Supervisar o acompañar la configuración de Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Content Builder, Contact Builder, Data Extensions, CloudPages y componentes relevantes del ecosistema Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
Definir modelos de segmentación, reglas de contacto, gobierno de audiencias, criterios de supresión, consentimiento, preferencia, frecuencia y personalización.
Colaborar con equipos de negocio, data, tecnología, creatividad, medios y operaciones para asegurar una implementación end-to-end eficiente, escalable y gobernada.

Trabajar de forma activa con equipos de medios para conectar audiencias CRM y first-party data con plataformas de activación pagada como Google DV360, Meta u otras plataformas de paid media, asegurando una visión integrada entre canales propios y medios pagados.

Establecer frameworks de medición que conecten métricas operativas como aperturas, clicks, bounces y entregabilidad con métricas de negocio como conversión, revenue, retención, CLV, cross-sell, up-sell y churn.
Identificar oportunidades de automatización, optimización de journeys, mejora de entregabilidad, limpieza de datos, integración de audiencias y escalamiento de capacidades MarTech.

Documentar procesos, mejores prácticas, modelos operativos, RACI, SLAs, lineamientos de uso y criterios de gobierno de Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
Más de 8 años de experiencia en CRM, marketing automation, marketing directo, customer engagement, MarTech o disciplinas relacionadas.

Experiencia comprobable en Salesforce Marketing Cloud, idealmente en roles como Marketing Cloud Consultant, CRM Manager, Marketing Automation Manager, CRM Strategist, CRM Project Manager o Salesforce Marketing Cloud Lead.
Experiencia práctica en implementación de campañas, journeys, automatizaciones, segmentaciones, data extensions, QA, reporting y operación de campañas de alto volumen.
Experiencia evolucionando desde una posición operativa o técnica hacia un rol estratégico, consultivo y orientado a negocio.
Conocimiento de modelos de datos, integración entre plataformas, Customer 360, Data Cloud, Sales/Service Cloud Connect, CDP o integraciones con plataformas externas será altamente valorado.

Experiencia trabajando con audiencias CRM conectadas a medios pagados, incluyendo coordinación con equipos de medios, definición de segmentos accionables y activación en plataformas como Google DV360, Meta u otras DSPs.
Experiencia en campañas de alto volumen, múltiples unidades de negocio, alta complejidad operativa, clientes regionales o entornos multi-agencia.
Capacidad para liderar conversaciones con stakeholders técnicos, comerciales, de marketing, data, tecnología y medios, desde equipos operativos hasta dirección.
Salesforce Marketing Cloud: Journey Builder, Email Studio, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Contact Builder y Data Extensions.

Entendimiento de HTML/CSS para campañas de email, QA de piezas y personalización dinámica.
Conocimiento de entregabilidad: calentamiento de IPs, reputación de dominio, bounces, spam complaints, frequency capping y reglas de contacto.

Organizar, planificar y priorizar la carga de trabajo según el plan de activación de tienda, y adaptarte a las necesidades del negocio junto al equipo de management y el área visual.
Implementar y mantener a tiempo las últimas activaciones globales y actividades de rebajas, al aplicar los estándares de la marca H&M.
Garantizar el cuidado adecuado de las prendas, mantener niveles óptimos de existencias y proporcionar información sobre asignación a los equipos de tienda y área.
Dar seguimiento a reportes de ventas (KPis), al identificar y priorizar las oportunidades visuales y comerciales junto al equipo de management.
Crear acciones eficientes para aumentar la satisfacción del cliente y alcanzar objetivos de ventas, metas de tienda y presupuesto, con planes de seguimiento coordinados con el equipo de management.
Cumplir con todos los procedimientos, mejores prácticas para servicios omnicanal, rutinas operativas, requisitos legales y comunicación en todas las áreas de la tienda junto al equipo.
Mantenerte actualizado sobre el mundo de la moda: tendencias, estilos, productos, marcas, competidores e influencers relevantes.

Dedicar tiempo al conocimiento de la moda y tendencias para comprender la teoría de tendencias, tableros de inspiración para técnicas de estilismo y presentación de productos, y así anticipar las necesidades de nuestros clientes y mejorar su experiencia de compra.

Compartir, inspirar y educar a los equipos de tienda, al mantenerlos actualizados sobre cambios estacionales, tendencias de moda, información visual y comercial relevante, comunicación en tienda y percepción de precios.
Capacitar y desarrollar las habilidades visuales y comerciales del equipo para garantizar presentaciones de producto de alta calidad según los lineamientos.
Apoyar y desarrollar rutinas diarias y mejores prácticas para tu equipo de tienda, con el fin de mantener los estándares visuales y comerciales consistentes sin descuidar el servicio al cliente.
Desarrollar y capacitar los talentos, al brindar formación de incorporación a los nuevos compañeros.
Organizar, impartir y realizar capacitaciones visuales y comerciales para ti y tus compañeros.
Completar las formaciones visuales y comerciales según los objetivos globales, regionales y del mercado de ventas.
Apoyar a los equipos de área y mercado de ventas con las necesidades de expansión (proyectos de tiendas).

Implementar la presentación visual, comercial y de estilismo en tienda según el calendario comercial, asignación de productos, plan de activación e historias de moda, al seguir los lineamientos visuales y comerciales.

Realizar rutinas de selección de muestras y aplicar mejores prácticas, incluidas las cantidades de prendas en almacén, accesorios y calzado, al crear historias de moda claras basadas en la inspiración de las guías visuales y comerciales.
Ejecutar montajes de ventanas y estilismos según los lineamientos para crear una experiencia inspiradora y comercialmente efectiva.
Garantizar un flujo óptimo de clientes mediante la disposición comercial de mobiliario que destaque los elementos visuales e historias de moda clave.
Garantizar un equilibrio adecuado y mantenimiento de señalización de precios en ventanas y toda la tienda, alineado con la estrategia global y requisitos del mercado local.

Colaborar con el equipo de facilities/mantenimiento para garantizar que toda la iluminación funcione correctamente misma que es diseñada para destacar productos y enfoques claves en ventanas y tienda.
Mantener y cuidar todos los visualizadores y materiales de interiorismo (mobiliario y accesorios) con enfoque en la sostenibilidad.
En coordinación con el área visual, garantizar que la navegación en tienda se mantenga actualizada según los últimos lineamientos y distribución.
Garantizar que la tienda cuente con materiales suficientes para rebajas y otras actividades, incluidos los puntos de venta, según las rutinas locales.
Mantener tanto el piso de ventas como el BOH limpios, organizados y seguros, al cumplir con las normativas locales de seguridad.

Para destacar como visual merchandiser, deberás ser curioso, creativo y siempre en busca de inspiración. Debes ser proactivo, orientado a las soluciones y flexible, con habilidades comunicativas para colaborar efectivamente entre áreas y lograr resultados.
Buscamos personas apasionadas por la moda con capacidad de liderazgo, que aprovechen su experiencia visual-comercial para desenvolverse en entornos dinámicos.
Eres experto en encontrar soluciones para mejorar la presentación de producto y la ejecución comercial en tienda.
Cuentas con amplio conocimiento de mejores prácticas, rutinas y herramientas visuales, comerciales y operativas.
Tienes habilidad para gestionar, dar seguimiento y actuar sobre ecuaciones de venta y reportes semanales.
Lideras con integridad y te adhieres a los estándares éticos de la marca.
Posees amplio interés y experiencia en la moda.
Tienes conocimientos sólidos sobre la presentación de producto, estilismo y comercial, al mantener altos estándares.
Tienes la capacidad para involucrarte, asumir responsabilidades y ofrecer retroalimentación constructiva de manera inspiradora.
Priorizas la experiencia del cliente y utilizas las habilidades de priorización para gestionar la retroalimentación de equipos de management y de área.
Tienes la capacidad de promover la lealtad del cliente y venta activa de productos.
Prosperas en entornos dinámicos y colaborativos, al trabajar con todo el equipo de tienda.
Gestionas tareas y consultas de clientes eficientemente.
Analizas datos para tomar decisiones informadas.
Eres orientado a las soluciones y adaptabilidad, alineadas con nuestros valores y cultura.
Aprovechas y te adaptas a las nuevas tecnologías implementadas en tienda.
Priorizas el crecimiento y aprendizaje propio y del equipo.
Ventas: Acogedor y centrado en el cliente / promoción y venta de productos / impulso de servicios omnicanal en tienda.
Personas y relaciones: Orientación al cliente / comunicación efectiva / capacitación de equipos / colaboración transversal / trabajo en equipo.
Tareas y proyectos: Curiosidad y creatividad / flexibilidad y adaptabilidad / conocimiento de tendencias e inspiración / orientación a soluciones / análisis de ventas.
Motivaciones y emociones: Apasionado y motivado / ágil / decisivo y orientado a la acción / solidario / resiliente

Crear acciones eficientes para aumentar la satisfacción del cliente y alcanzar objetivos de ventas, metas de tienda y presupuesto, con planes de seguimiento coordinados con el equipo de management. 
Cumplir con todos los procedimientos, mejores prácticas para servicios omnicanal, rutinas operativas, requisitos legales y comunicación en todas las áreas de la tienda junto al equipo. 

Moda y tendencias



Mantenerte actualizado sobre el mundo de la moda: tendencias, estilos, productos, marcas, competidores e influencers relevantes. 
Dedicar tiempo al conocimiento de la moda y tendencias para comprender la teoría de tendencias, tableros de inspiración para técnicas de estilismo y presentación de productos, y así anticipar las necesidades de nuestros clientes y mejorar su experiencia de compra. 

Equipo y desarrollo



Compartir, inspirar y educar a los equipos de tienda, al mantenerlos actualizados sobre cambios estacionales, tendencias de moda, información visual y comercial relevante, comunicación en tienda y percepción de precios. 
Capacitar y desarrollar las habilidades visuales y comerciales del equipo para garantizar presentaciones de producto de alta calidad según los lineamientos. 
Apoyar y desarrollar rutinas diarias y mejores prácticas para tu equipo de tienda, con el fin de mantener los estándares visuales y comerciales consistentes sin descuidar el servicio al cliente. 
Desarrollar y capacitar los talentos, al brindar formación de incorporación a los nuevos compañeros. 
Organizar, impartir y realizar capacitaciones visuales y comerciales para ti y tus compañeros. 
Completar las formaciones visuales y comerciales según los objetivos globales, regionales y del mercado de ventas. 
Apoyar a los equipos de área y mercado de ventas con las necesidades de expansión (proyectos de tiendas). 

Ejecución Visual y Comercial



Implementar la presentación visual, comercial y de estilismo en tienda según el calendario comercial, asignación de productos, plan de activación e historias de moda, al seguir los lineamientos visuales y comerciales. 
Realizar rutinas de selección de muestras y aplicar mejores prácticas, incluidas las cantidades de prendas en almacén, accesorios y calzado, al crear historias de moda claras basadas en la inspiración de las guías visuales y comerciales. 
Ejecutar montajes de ventanas y estilismos según los lineamientos para crear una experiencia inspiradora y comercialmente efectiva. 
Garantizar un flujo óptimo de clientes mediante la disposición comercial de mobiliario que destaque los elementos visuales e historias de moda clave. 
Garantizar un equilibrio adecuado y mantenimiento de señalización de precios en ventanas y toda la tienda, alineado con la estrategia global y requisitos del mercado local. 
Colaborar con el equipo de facilities/mantenimiento para garantizar que toda la iluminación funcione correctamente misma que es diseñada para destacar productos y enfoques claves en ventanas y tienda. 
Mantener y cuidar todos los visualizadores y materiales de interiorismo (mobiliario y accesorios) con enfoque en la sostenibilidad. 
En coordinación con el área visual, garantizar que la navegación en tienda se mantenga actualizada según los últimos lineamientos y distribución. 
Garantizar que la tienda cuente con materiales suficientes para rebajas y otras actividades, incluidos los puntos de venta, según las rutinas locales. 
Mantener tanto el piso de ventas como el BOH limpios, organizados y seguros, al cumplir con las normativas locales de seguridad. 

 





Qualifications



¿Quién eres?



Para destacar como visual merchandiser, deberás ser curioso, creativo y siempre en busca de inspiración. Debes ser proactivo, orientado a las soluciones y flexible, con habilidades comunicativas para colaborar efectivamente entre áreas y lograr resultados. 
Buscamos personas apasionadas por la moda con capacidad de liderazgo, que aprovechen su experiencia visual-comercial para desenvolverse en entornos dinámicos. 
Eres experto en encontrar soluciones para mejorar la presentación de producto y la ejecución comercial en tienda. 
Cuentas con amplio conocimiento de mejores prácticas, rutinas y herramientas visuales, comerciales y operativas. 
Tienes habilidad para gestionar, dar seguimiento y actuar sobre ecuaciones de venta y reportes semanales. 
Lideras con integridad y te adhieres a los estándares éticos de la marca. 
Posees amplio interés y experiencia en la moda. 
Tienes conocimientos sólidos sobre la presentación de producto, estilismo y comercial, al mantener altos estándares. 
Tienes la capacidad para involucrarte, asumir responsabilidades y ofrecer retroalimentación constructiva de manera inspiradora. 
Priorizas la experiencia del cliente y utilizas las habilidades de priorización para gestionar la retroalimentación de equipos de management y de área. 
Tienes la capacidad de promover la lealtad del cliente y venta activa de productos. 
Prosperas en entornos dinámicos y colaborativos, al trabajar con todo el equipo de tienda. 
Gestionas tareas y consultas de clientes eficientemente. 
Analizas datos para tomar decisiones informadas. 
Eres orientado a las soluciones y adaptabilidad, alineadas con nuestros valores y cultura. 
Aprovechas y te adaptas a las nuevas tecnologías implementadas en tienda. 
Priorizas el crecimiento y aprendizaje propio y del equipo. 
Ventas: Acogedor y centrado en el cliente / promoción y venta de productos / impulso de servicios omnicanal en tienda. 
Personas y relaciones: Orientación al cliente / comunicación efectiva / capacitación de equipos / colaboración transversal / trabajo en equipo. 
Tareas y proyectos: Curiosidad y creatividad / flexibilidad y adaptabilidad / conocimiento de tendencias e inspiración / orientación a soluciones / análisis de ventas. 
Motivaciones y emociones: Apasionado y motivado / ágil / decisivo y orientado a la acción / solidario / resiliente

description:
About the job

Internship Opportunity - Music Marketing - LATAM




About Those Days




Those Days is a creative marketing company helping artists, brands, and cultural organizations earn attention online.




We build campaigns across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, creator communities, fan pages, AI content, and digital culture.




Today we work primarily with the music industry. Over time we’ll apply the same creative and marketing systems to brands, sports, tourism, film, and other industries.




We’re a small team building from the ground up. That means everyone has ownership, moves fast, and helps shape how the company operates.




The Role




We’re looking for our first Campaign Manager.

Your job is simple: make sure every campaign gets delivered at the highest possible standard.




You’ll coordinate creators, editors, designers, AI operators, and clients while keeping projects organized, moving, and on schedule.




You’ll work closely with the founders to turn ideas into systems, improve workflows, and help build the operational backbone of the company.




You’ll be solving problems every day, improving processes, and helping build a company from scratch.




Responsibilities




* Own the planning and execution of marketing campaigns from start to finish.

* Build and manage relationships with creators, fan pages, community admins, editors, and other digital partners.

* Continuously grow and organize our network across genres, countries, platforms, and online communities.

* Identify emerging trends, fandom behaviors, and cultural moments that can become marketing opportunities.

* Develop creative activation ideas that feel native to each artist, community, and platform.

* Coordinate campaign execution across internal and external collaborators.

* Maintain direct communication with clients, providing updates and ensuring projects move forward smoothly.

* Review campaign performance, document learnings, and improve future executions.

* Help design better workflows, systems, and AI-powered processes as the company grows.

* Take full ownership of your projects and operate with a high level of independence.




What We’re Looking For




* Passionate about music, internet culture, and how content spreads online.

* Deep understanding of fandoms, niche communities, memes, and digital behavior.

* Strong creative instincts and the ability to generate organic marketing ideas.

* Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

* Highly independent, proactive, and comfortable making decisions without constant direction.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.

* Experience working with creators, fan communities, influencer marketing, community management, social media, or digital marketing.

* Curious about AI and excited to integrate new tools into everyday work.

* No specific degree required. We care much more about your experience, curiosity, and ability to execute.




You’ll thrive in this role if you: 




* Naturally notice trends before they become mainstream.

* Spend time exploring TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, Discord, or emerging platforms because you genuinely enjoy it.

* Like building relationships and becoming part of different online communities.

* Enjoy turning creative ideas into structured execution.

* Take ownership instead of waiting for instructions.

* Want to build something for the long term.




How to Apply




Send to felipe@thosedays.co




* A short introduction about yourself.

* Something you’ve built or worked on that you’re proud of (personal projects are absolutely welcome).

* Why you want to join Those Days.




We’re much more interested in your curiosity, initiative, and creativity than in your CV.

About the job

Company

Qualcomm Intl Inc., Mexico Branch Office

Job Area

Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group, Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group > Marketing Communications

General Summary

Qualcomm relentlessly innovates to deliver intelligent computing everywhere, helping the world tackle its most important challenges. Our proven solutions are transforming major industries and our Snapdragon® platforms power extraordinary consumer experiences. Building on our nearly 40-year leadership in setting industry standards, we deliver leading-edge AI, high performance, low-power computing, and unrivaled connectivity to the global ecosystem, enabling next-generation digital transformation. At Qualcomm, we are engineering human progress.

Marketing Communications Specialist, Staff: Video Editing and Multimedia Production (Mexico City)

Role Overview

Qualcomm’s Creative Studio team is looking for a video editor and multimedia producer with a proven track record of creating compelling videos that advance brands and achieve business objectives. This role seeks a storyteller with a passion for filmmaking and graphics who can bring narratives to life on screen. The position includes developing videos across many platforms, from short mobile phone clips for social media to highly produced films for large-stage keynotes. The ideal candidate is a creative thinker and problem solver who thrives in a high-stakes, high-pressure environment.

The Creative Studio is a dynamic and innovative team that delivers world-class creative solutions to support Qualcomm’s business objectives. The team works closely across the company’s marketing organization and with outside agency partners on projects across a wide range of mediums, including graphic and multimedia design, copy, video, environmental and experiential design, and live event visuals. This position is based in Qualcomm’s growing creative hub in Mexico City, which sits at the center of an evolving and ambitious creative strategy for the company. The team values creativity, collaboration, and a can-do attitude.

Job Summary

This role includes every aspect of post-production, including editing, creation of motion graphics, music supervision, sound design, color correction, and more. The ability to be nimble and turn edits quickly is required, as is the ability to stitch together a diverse collection of footage into a single, compelling story.

The role also requires proficiency in visual effects and the ability to independently conceptualize and create multimedia sequences based on strong knowledge of company brands and business objectives.

This position sits within Qualcomm’s Creative Studio and collaborates with other creators, including writers and visual designers. The role requires a self-starter who can work independently while also being a consensus builder who thrives as part of a team. The candidate will manage multiple projects with varying scopes and deadlines concurrently, track fast-moving timelines and logistics, and communicate clearly and in a timely manner. Comfort working in an engineering-focused technology environment is required.

Please provide a resume in English. A portfolio review and discussion will be part of the interview process.

This is an office-based position in Mexico City and requires on-site work five days per week.

Key Responsibilities


Independently handle post-production of small- and mid-sized video projects, including:
Editing content from multiple sources into cohesive videos aligned to creative briefs
Selecting voiceover talent and music and editing and optimizing sound
Performing color correction and grading
Creating and integrating motion graphics
Outputting videos for multiple formats, including short vertical social cuts and longer widescreen keynote opening videos

Collaborate as part of a team on larger, multi-faceted video projects 


Minimum Qualifications


 Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or related work experience.



OR

Associate's degree and 5+ years of Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or related work experience.

OR

High School Diploma or equivalent and 7+ years of Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or related work experience.


Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.



Required Skills


Strong understanding of post-production workflows, including editing, motion graphics, sound design, and color correction
Proven ability to create high-quality, visually compelling videos for a wide range of applications
Understanding of current tools and trends in video production and motion graphics, including the use of generative AI tools as part of creative workflows
Familiarity with social media video formats and best practices, including YouTube and Instagram
Creative thinking and problem-solving skills
Advanced communication skills in English
Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment

About Spotlight Media

Spotlight Media is a leading TikTok Shop Partner agency, scaling some of the most recognizable brands in the new age of social commerce. Unlike traditional agencies, we don’t believe in cookie-cutter playbooks- every strategy we craft is custom-built to unlock our clients’ full potential on TikTok Shop. As a TikTok Shop–only agency, our entire focus, from the initiatives we pursue to the talent we hire, is singularly dedicated to driving growth on the platform.

We’ve guided brands through the full funnel- from launch to scaling into the millions in GMV-and we’re just getting started.

We believe the future of e-commerce is social. That’s why we’re building a team of high-agency individuals who thrive on ownership, autonomy, and speed. Spotlight is not just a place to execute campaigns-it’s a blank canvas where ambitious people can build real leverage, take on increasing responsibility, and grow into senior operators quickly. Our culture is high-performing, entrepreneurial, and unapologetically ambitious.

Join us, and you’ll have the trust, resources, and runway to redefine what’s possible for the world’s leading brands.

The Role

We are hiring a Creator Campaign Coordinator to support the execution of paid creator campaigns across our portfolio of TikTok Shop brands. Working closely with our US-based Creator Management team, you will coordinate the day-to-day operations of creator partnerships throughout the full campaign lifecycle — from identifying and engaging creators through contracting, onboarding, content delivery, and campaign close-out.

This role is central to how our campaigns run: brands entrust us with significant budgets each month, and the coordinator's work ensures every campaign is fully staffed, every creator is supported, and every deliverable is completed on schedule. It is a high-volume, detail-driven position best suited to someone who has managed paid creator collaborations professionally and enjoys being the person who keeps everything moving.

We are specifically looking for candidates with prior experience at an influencer marketing, UGC, creator management, or talent agency, where they personally coordinated paid creator partnerships end to end.

Key Responsibilities


Identify and evaluate creators for paid campaigns based on brand fit, content quality, and campaign requirements
Manage creator outreach and follow-up communications across email, SMS, and social channels until each campaign is fully staffed
Administer creator agreements and onboarding, including contract delivery, signature collection, and documentation
Coordinate product logistics with participating creators and confirm receipt ahead of production timelines
Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for creators during active campaigns, providing timely, professional support
Track contracted deliverables from kickoff through final posting, proactively following up to keep campaigns on schedule
Support creator payment workflows, ensuring documentation is accurate and submitted on time
Maintain accurate, up-to-date campaign records and provide regular status reporting to the Creator Management team


Qualifications


2+ years of experience at an influencer marketing, UGC, creator management, or talent agency, with direct, hands-on responsibility for paid creator collaborations
Demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of concurrent creator partnerships without losing track of details or timelines
Excellent written and verbal English (C1 or above); all creator and internal communication is conducted in English
Exceptional organization, attention to detail, and follow-through
A professional, relationship-oriented communication style — able to hold creators to deadlines and quality standards while maintaining strong working relationships
Proficiency with spreadsheets, project trackers, and CRM or creator-management platforms

Preferred

Familiarity with creator discovery and campaign management platforms
