title: Coordinadora de marketing digital
description:
About the job

HiperTexto Netizen, https://hipertexto.com.co 

 

CONVOCATORIA LABORAL EN MÉXICO

COORDINADORA DE MARKETING DIGITAL




La posición es responsable de la ejecución y el desempeño de los canales digitales de las librerías online Tinta y Sol (México) y Librería de la U (Colombia), cubriendo todo el embudo —alcance, consideración, conversión y fidelización— a través de pauta digital, contenido, e-commerce, canales B2B y relación con editoriales [CM1] y de marketplaces y actividades de marketing en la república mexicana. Se busca un perfil con capacidad de ejecutar estrategia, contenido visual y operación de forma simultánea, persona activa y con un amplio nivel de comunicación y relaciones públicas, con enfoque comercial.




Alcance regional: el foco prioritario es el crecimiento del mercado mexicano, donde la persona opera desde Ciudad de México. De forma complementaria, produce y adapta contenido, campañas y activaciones para la operación de Colombia, en coordinación con el equipo de Bogotá, aprovechando el catálogo y las alianzas editoriales compartidas entre ambos países.




 Salario:

 A convenir (según experiencia y competencias)

 Vinculación:

 Inmediata

 

2. Alcance de la responsabilidad

La estrategia de marketing, la identidad de marca y la aprobación de planes, presupuestos y piezas corresponden a la Dirección de Marketing. Dentro de ese marco, el cargo responde directamente por:

● El cumplimiento de las metas de venta, tráfico y conversión asignadas a los canales digitales bajo su gestión, con apertura por país.

● La entrega puntual del plan de medios, el calendario de activaciones y las piezas creativas para su aprobación, con la anticipación que defina la Dirección de Marketing.

● La ejecución fiel y oportuna de todo lo aprobado: que cada campaña, publicación y envío salga en la fecha, el canal y las condiciones acordadas.

● El desempeño diario de las campañas ya aprobadas: optimización de pujas, audiencias y distribución del presupuesto autorizado para maximizar el ROAS.

● La integridad operativa de los canales: exactitud de precios y fichas, disponibilidad publicada, reputación de vendedor en marketplaces y tiempos de respuesta al usuario[CM3] .

● El reporte de resultados en la periodicidad definida, incluyendo la explicación de las desviaciones y la propuesta de acciones correctivas.

Requieren aprobación previa de la Dirección de Marketing: la estrategia y el plan de medios, el monto y la reasignación del presupuesto de pauta, las piezas y copy antes de su publicación, los precios y descuentos promocionales, y cualquier acuerdo comercial con editoriales o aliados.




3. Funciones principales

Estrategia y pauta digital

● Proponer la estrategia de marketing 360º para los canales digitales bajo su gestión —con prioridad en México y participación en la operación de Colombia— y ejecutarla una vez aprobada.[CM4] 

● Planear, briefar y optimizar campañas de pauta en Meta Ads (Instagram / Facebook) y Google Ads dentro del presupuesto autorizado, con seguimiento de CPC, CPM, ROAS, CTR y CPA, gestionando cuentas y audiencias diferenciadas por país.

● Construir y someter a aprobación el calendario mensual de activaciones para ambos mercados, cruzando datos de venta, tráfico y tendencias culturales y editoriales, y respetando los calendarios propios de cada país (ferias, temporadas académicas y fechas comerciales).

Contenido y redes sociales

● Gestionar las redes sociales orgánicas —Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn y YouTube—: calendario, publicación y análisis de desempeño por canal y por país.

● Crear y editar contenido visual y gráfico (piezas de feed, stories, reels y banners) con ejecución directa, no únicamente brief a diseño.

● Producir contenido para la operación de Colombia y adaptar a México el contenido generado en Bogotá, cuidando la localización de tono, referencias culturales, moneda y disponibilidad de catálogo en cada país.

● Redactar copy y conceptos creativos con storytelling editorial.

● Gestionar el e-mail marketing: segmentación de bases, diseño HTML responsive y pruebas A/B de líneas de asunto.

E-commerce

● Administrar la experiencia de usuario e interfaz del e-commerce en Magento: fichas de producto, categorías, banners, navegación y checkout.

● Crear y publicar contenido directamente en los sitios de México y Colombia: novedades, destacados, promociones y páginas de campaña.

● Ejecutar SEO de producto, categoría y blog, con fundamentos de GEO/AEO (contenido optimizado para respuestas generadas por inteligencia artificial).

Marketplaces

● Gestionar los canales marketplaces de ambos países —MercadoLibre México y Colombia, Amazon y Buscalibre—: publicaciones, posicionamiento en búsqueda, precios y reputación de vendedor.

● Vigilar la consistencia de precio, disponibilidad y ficha entre los marketplaces y las tiendas propias de cada mercado.

Canal B2B y alianzas

● Gestionar estrategias de venta B2B dirigidas a instituciones académicas, bibliotecas, empresas y regalos corporativos, en México y Colombia.

● Administrar la relación con editoriales y clientes aliados, llevando las negociaciones de contenido promocional y condiciones comerciales conjuntas hasta su aprobación, y coordinando la ejecución de las campañas co–branded.

● Aprovechar las alianzas editoriales regionales para lanzar campañas simultáneas en los dos países cuando el catálogo y los derechos lo permitan.

WhatsApp y punto de venta

● Ejecutar campañas de fidelización y conversión vía WhatsApp: notificaciones, seguimiento y atención postventa.

● Apoyar los materiales , activaciones de punto de venta y apoyo en ferias del libro cuando aplique.[CM5] 

Analítica y conocimiento de mercado

● Cruzar datos de ventas (ERP e inventario), analítica web (GA4) y tendencias del mercado editorial para detectar oportunidades y anomalías, para México, debe ser coordinado con la Gerencia de Distribución Internacional.[CM6] 

● Conectar el catálogo con los momentos culturales relevantes de cada país, a partir de un conocimiento sólido de libros, autores, géneros y tendencias de lectura.

● Reportar los KPI de negocio con apertura por país: ventas, tráfico, conversión, CAC, ROAS, ticket promedio y open rate.

● Identificar qué campañas y aprendizajes de un mercado son replicables en el otro, y proponer su adaptación.




4. Perfil profesional requerido

Formación académica

Obligatorio: Licenciatura concluida en alguna de las siguientes áreas:

● Mercadotecnia o Marketing Digital

● Comunicación, Publicidad o Diseño de la Comunicación Gráfica

● Administración de Empresas o Negocios Internacionales

● Letras, Edición o carreras afines al sector editorial y cultural




Experiencia laboral

Mínimo 2 años —idealmente entre 2 y 4— de experiencia comprobable en:

● Marketing digital en e-commerce, retail o sector editorial y cultural.

● Gestión de pauta en Meta Ads y Google Ads con manejo directo de presupuesto.

● Administración de catálogo, categorías y fichas de producto.

● Gestión de marketplaces —MercadoLibre, Amazon, Buscalibre.

● Gestión de redes sociales orgánicas multicanal y creación de piezas listas para publicar.

● Deseable: haber trabajado con más de un mercado de Iberoamérica o con equipos distribuidos en distintos países.




5. Competencias y habilidades

Técnicas

● Pauta digital: Meta Ads y Google Ads

● Magento: administración de catálogo y contenido

● Google Analytics 4

● Herramientas de email marketing (Connectif, Klaviyo, Mailchimp o similares)

● Diseño y edición de contenido visual: Canva, Figma o Adobe (Photoshop / Illustrator)

● SEO de producto, categoría y blog; fundamentos de GEO/AEO

● Manejo de marketplaces y herramientas de gestión de publicaciones

Transversales

● Pensamiento analítico y estratégico, con decisiones basadas en datos cruzados

● Sensibilidad editorial y cultural, con capacidad de storytelling

● Autonomía en la ejecución y disciplina para trabajar dentro de lineamientos aprobados: perfil híbrido estratega, creativo y operativo

● Responsabilidad sobre resultados: capacidad de explicar desviaciones y proponer correctivos sin esperar a que se los pidan

● Habilidad de negociación y relacionamiento con editoriales y aliados comerciales

● Comunicación directa y orientación a resultados

● Gestión del tiempo y trabajo en equipo, con capacidad de operar dos mercados en paralelo sin perder foco en las prioridades de México

● Sensibilidad para leer las diferencias culturales y de consumo entre México y Colombia

● Interés genuino por los libros, los autores y las tendencias de lectura

 

6. Condiciones de trabajo

● Modalidad: Híbrido con mayor enfoque en Home Office

Our campaigns have generated millions in Kickstarter pledges and eCommerce revenue for brands like Ravensburger, Roll20, Paizo, and Pandasaurus. Demonstrated ability to personally produce high-performing static and simple motion ads for paid digital campaigns, with speed and consistency.
Strong portfolio of direct-response ad creative, ideally showing work built from client-provided assets (performance ads matter more than brand campaigns).
Experience developing creative that drives performance metrics such as CTR, ROAS, conversions, and customer acquisition.
Experience mentoring or managing designers in a remote setting, giving effective creative feedback, and improving team processes.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and related design tools, with an efficient, template-smart workflow.
Highly self-directed, with strong communication and organizational skills and the confidence to own your workload in a fully remote environment.
Strong English speaking and writing skills.

A genuine personal interest in tabletop gaming. 
Familiarity with gaming culture more broadly, including Kickstarter launches, conventions, and the communities around them.
Experience designing for niche or enthusiast audiences.
Creative writing abilities to take general concepts and add compelling copy




Your responsibility will include (but not limited to):

Deliver work reliably on quick timelines that support ongoing creative testing and iteration.

Fully remote work environment.

Direct exposure to a fast-moving, performance-driven creative team.

Experience: 2–3+ years of proven experience in social media management, short-form video editing, or digital executive assistance. Experience supporting US-based home services or blue-collar industries is a massive plus.

Soft Skills & Cultural Fit

Confident & Direct Communicator: A strong, vibrant personality who speaks up, handles objections gracefully, and is comfortable maintaining accountability with business leadership.
Independent Problem Solver: A right-brain creative who can also think logically on the backend; someone who connects the dots independently rather than relying on micro-management.

Social Media Content Creator & Brand Executor

Job ID: RANDJ2

Industry: Health & Wellness | Medical Aesthetics | Telehealth 🩺✨

Location: LATAM 🌎 (Spanish Required)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Schedule: Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST ⏰

Compensation: 💰 $8–$12/hour (Based on Experience & Skills)

Start Date: ASAP 🚀

About the Role




We are building an integrated wellness ecosystem and we need someone who creates content that

actually performs. The brand foundation, voice guidelines, and content pillars are already built. We are

not looking for a strategist. We need a bilingual content creator and executor who can script, shoot,

edit, and publish short-form video and social content across two distinct brands, working within an

existing creative framework and growing both audiences with speed and consistency.




This role spans two brands: Eterna Aesthetics & Wellness, a luxury brick-and-mortar medical aesthetics

clinic serving a Spanish-speaking Latina clientele in Orlando, and Aevra Health, a national concierge

telehealth platform specializing in advanced wellness and metabolic optimization. Both brands have

distinct voices, audiences, and content needs. You will execute across both.

A portfolio is required. You must be able to show prior content work, brand execution, and measurable

results before moving to the interview stage.




Key Responsibilities




1. Short-Form Video Creation (Priority #1)




• Script, shoot, direct, and edit Reels and TikToks for both brands at a pace of 4 to 6 pieces of short-

form content per week, per brand.

• Apply high-retention video frameworks including hooks, pacing, and storytelling to maximize

organic reach and watch time.

• Produce bilingual content with Spanish-first priority for Eterna's local Latina audience and English-

primary for Aevra Health's national audience.

• Repurpose long-form content and client testimonials into short-form clips across TikTok, Instagram

Reels, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts.




2. Content Execution Across Platforms




• Own the publishing calendar across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube for both brands.

• Design and produce premium static content using our custom visual identity — not generic

healthcare templates. Proficiency in Canva is required; Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator

experience is a strong plus.

• Build and manage a content bank of templates, b-roll, and evergreen assets to maintain posting

consistency.

• Write bilingual captions and hooks in both English and Spanish that drive engagement and reflect

each brand's distinct voice, delivering culturally nuanced copy — never a literal translation.




3. ManyChat & Audience Engagement




• Manage and expand ManyChat automations on Instagram and TikTok to convert comments and

DMs into booked appointments and qualified leads.

• Monitor and respond to comments and DMs in both English and Spanish, maintaining brand tone

across all interactions.

• Build comment-to-DM flows that funnel followers into the booking widget without manual follow-

up.




4. Google Business Profile & Reviews




• Maintain and optimize Google Business Profile listings for local SEO.

• Respond to client reviews in both English and Spanish and repurpose high-quality reviews into

social media brand assets.

• Support systems that consistently generate new high-star reviews from existing clients.




5. Compliance-Safe Copywriting




• Frame all content around lifestyle transformations, wellness outcomes, and confidence rather than

medical claims, protecting ad accounts and organic channels from platform restrictions.

• Understand compliant aesthetics marketing and apply it consistently without needing reminders.




6. SOPs and Workflow Documentation




• Document content workflows, brand standards, and repeatable processes in Notion so the creative

system scales as the team grows.

• Build asset templates and content libraries that allow production to continue consistently without

bottlenecks.




What This Role Is Not




The brand strategy, content pillars, and visual identity already exist. You are not being hired to build

those from scratch. You are being hired to execute them at high volume and high quality. GHL

automations, lead qualification funnels, and CRM pipeline management are handled by a separate

operations team member and are not part of this role.




Requirements




Portfolio: Required. Must demonstrate prior content work, brand design, and measurable results before

moving to the interview stage.

Language: Native or professional bilingual fluency in written and spoken English and Spanish is strictly

required. Spanish-first content for Eterna's Latina audience is non-negotiable.

Experience: 2 to 4 plus years creating content for social media brands with measurable results. Proven

track record in short-form video content that has grown audiences or generated significant organic

reach.

Video & Design: Proficient in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or equivalent for video editing. Canva

proficiency required. Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator experience is a strong plus.

Platform Knowledge: Deep understanding of TikTok and Instagram algorithm behavior, content formats,

and optimization strategies including social SEO, hashtags, captions, and posting cadence.

Tech Stack: ManyChat experience is required. Familiarity with GoHighLevel, Meta Business Suite, Notion

or Asana, and Google Business Dashboard is a strong plus.

Healthcare/Aesthetics: Background in medical aesthetics, luxury wellness, beauty, or lifestyle content is

highly preferred. Must understand how to market in a regulated industry without making medical

claims.

Documentation Mindset: Comfortable building SOPs and documenting workflows, not just executing

tasks. Treats documentation as part of the deliverable.

Preferred

• Background in medical aesthetics, luxury wellness, telehealth, or premium healthcare marketing.

• Experience with AI-driven automation and funnel-building beyond basic tool use.

• Agency background with experience managing content across multiple brands simultaneously.

Who You Are

• You create content because you understand what makes people stop scrolling, not because you

have a template for it.

• You are bilingual in practice, not just on paper. You write Spanish copy that converts, not just

translates.

• You are organized enough to run multiple brand calendars simultaneously without dropping the

ball.

• You take initiative. If something is broken or missing, you fix it and document it rather than waiting

to be told.

• You think in systems and build infrastructure as you go so nothing depends on you alone.

• You thrive in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift and speed matters.

description:
About the job

Responsibilities

About the team

TikTok Shop's Governance and Experience (GNE) is a global team that safeguards trust across our e-commerce marketplace — for buyers, sellers, and creators alike. We set the policies and rules that help sellers and creators grow in a fair, thriving ecosystem, detect and prevent fraud and abuse, and design the service and experience that resolve issues and build lasting trust with our customers. Partnering closely with business, product, engineering, and legal teams — and increasingly harnessing AI to govern and serve at scale — our work is what lets buyers shop with confidence, sellers and creators grow sustainably, and the business scale worldwide.

We're looking for passionate, curious people who care deeply about user experience and thrive on complex, high-stakes challenges. If you want your ideas to matter and your work to drive real impact, join us in building the future of e-commerce.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.

Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.

Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.

What's this role about?

The Governance team builds a thriving, safe, and fair marketplace ecosystem on TikTok Shop — shaping the policies, programs, and risk controls that help sellers and creators grow responsibly. As a Governance Intern, you'll work on real projects with the [Region] team and get first-hand exposure to how a global platform designs and enforces its rules at scale, including with AI.

Examples Of What You'll Work On


 Assist in research on market regulations, industry practices, and emerging risks.
 Support data checks and analysis to monitor governance metrics and identify trends or root causes
 Help review real cases to surface insights that inform policy and enforcement improvements
 Support AI-assisted governance workflows: e.g. helping test prompts and evaluate the quality of AI-assisted outcomes
 Help prepare documentation, reporting, and cross-team communication for governance programs.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


 Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Data Science, Law/Public Policy, or related fields.
 Able to commit to a full-time internship of at least 3 months (please state your availability in your resume)
 Professional proficiency in English and Spanish
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable working with data
 Proactive, curious, and eager to learn in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment


Preferred Qualifications


 Comfort using AI tools in daily work is a plus; SQL/Python is a plus


Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

title: Senior Enterprise Account Manager
description:
About the job

BPOD LatAm is seeking an experienced Senior Enterprise Account Manager for Enterprise Software, based in Mexico City, Mexico.







Mission







We are seeking a results-oriented Senior Enterprise Account Manager to own the full sales cycle to drive revenue growth, strengthen customer relationships, and expand strategic business opportunities across a territory of enterprise accounts. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing long-term partnerships with key stakeholders, understanding customers' business objectives, and delivering solutions that create measurable business value.

The Senior Enterprise Account Manager will work cross-functionally with sales, marketing, customer success, product, and technical teams to ensure customer satisfaction, retention, and growth. This role is ideal for a consultative seller with experience in enterprise SaaS and complex, multi-stakeholder sales environments.







Responsibilities







· Create and implement a territory plan to build the pipeline and close new business to achieve revenue and growth targets.

· Manage and grow a portfolio of enterprise-level customer accounts across Mexico and potentially in other Latin American countries, while developing strategic account plans.

· Build strong relationships with executive stakeholders, decision-makers, and influencers within customer organizations.

· Identify upselling, cross-selling, and new business opportunities.

· Understand customer business goals, challenges, and industry trends to position relevant solutions.

· Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through negotiation and contract execution.

· Coordinate internal resources to ensure successful solution delivery and customer satisfaction.

· Conduct regular business reviews and present performance metrics, recommendations, and growth strategies.

· Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, forecasting, and activity reporting using CRM tools.

· Monitor market trends, competitive activities, and emerging customer needs.

· Collaborate with Sales Development, Marketing, Product, Solutions Consulting, and Customer Success.

· Ensure high levels of customer retention and advocacy.

What success looks like

· Strong pipeline development and disciplined territory management.

· Ability to translate customer pain points into business outcomes.

· Consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets.

· Executive presence and strong communication skills across multiple functions.

· Reliable forecasting and deal discipline.







Qualifications










· Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Sales, Management, or a related field.

· 5+ years of quota-carrying SaaS or enterprise software sales experience

· Proven track record of selling complex solutions to mid-market or enterprise customers.

· Strong consultative selling, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-management skills.

· Experience managing complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, including C-level executives.

· Ability to develop strategic account plans and execute growth initiatives.

· Proficiency with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar tools.

· Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

· Knowledge of enterprise procurement and contract management processes.










BPOD is a space for inclusion and diversity.

Here, we believe in building relationships grounded in trust, closeness, teamwork, and respect, while fostering professional development by supporting team members in their growth and progression within the organization.
